analysis.headline: Cyber Risk Across Browsers, Contractors and Infrastructure
paragraphs: The top stories span industrial-control advisories, browser extensions, a contractor intrusion and reported attacker use of AI. The snippets provide limited technical detail, but together they show how cyber risk appears across software, services and operational environments.

The extension campaign involved reported installations at scale, while the contractor says its probe found no data extraction. Those reports concern different kinds of exposure: unwanted search redirection and a claimed absence of data theft. Analysts should keep the distinction clear and attribute claims.

The industrial advisories and suspected military-base freezer hack bring operational systems into view, while Microsoft describes varying AI adoption by North Korean threat actors. These reports may make it useful to watch for further technical details, affected systems and evidence that clarifies scope.
takeaways: Audit browser extensions and investigate unexpected search changes.
Attribute incident claims and track updates that clarify scope.
Watch for technical details in industrial and operational-system reports.
